findings.problem: The card shows "Couldn’t file these as backlog issues: {error}" over plain suggestions. With no filed fixes there is no Plan a goal, no retry, and no text on what to do next, so the review's suggestions can't be acted on from here.
findings.principle: Help users recover from errors [NNG-H9]; no dead ends [NNG-H3]
findings.fix: Add a Retry button in the card head, where Plan a goal sits, and end the line with what happens next: "Couldn’t file these as backlog issues: {error}. Retry to file them again." Retry would be a new one-click signal and may need a board endpoint, so it needs the owner's OK.

findings.title: Overview cards stay at minimum width beside an empty column, and cut text has no way to be read
findings.element: Overview › webapp card › v0.11.1 row at 1360x860 (releases-dark-m.png); also project page headlines and task titles
findings.problem: columns() gives 3 columns at 1360 and pads the row with an empty filler, so 2 projects sit at about 342px with the right third of the page blank. In that narrow card the Failed row cuts its time to 'Oct 21, 8:38…', losing the AM/PM the owner requires. Release headlines and task titles also truncate with no tooltip, although kit::clipped exists for this.
findings.principle: Show more on large displays and reflow across the window range [HIG-MACOS]; the owner's 12-hour AM/PM rule; content isn't lost at any size [WCAG 1.4.10]
findings.fix: Clamp columns to min(columns, projects.len()) and cap a card at about 520px so the filler goes. In the card's earlier-release rows show the date only ('Oct 21'), since the full time is one click away, or put the Failed pill beside the name. Replace .truncate() on headlines, task titles and Next cut titles with kit::clipped.

findings.title: Clicking the newest release lands on Unreleased in short windows
findings.element: Overview › version block → Project page › v0.13.0 at 900x560 (position inferred from rel-panel-dark-s.png)
findings.problem: The newest release shares Item::Top with the header and Unreleased, so focusing it scrolls to item 0. Unreleased alone fills a 560px window, so the release the owner just clicked is below the fold and nothing shows the click did what it said. Older rows have a smaller form of this: scroll_to_reveal_item may leave the row at the bottom of the view with its detail below the fold (not observed).
findings.principle: After an action, the user sees progress toward the goal [NNG-CW]; keep focus on what was opened [NNG-H1]
findings.fix: Split Item::Top into Header, Unreleased and Newest list items, and scroll the target to the top of the view for both the newest and older releases. Show a 1-second t.panel_2 highlight on the row reached.

findings.title: Next cut and the Unreleased list below it don't add up
findings.element: Project page › Unreleased section at 1360x860 (rel-webapp-dark-m.png)
findings.problem: T1 is Done in Next cut but is in no group below, and T68 is listed as waited-for but not in the tally of '3 tasks · 1 goal'. G4 reads '2 of 3' above and '2 tasks' below with no stated link, and T68 may be G4's third task, listed as a sibling of its own goal. The owner can't tell what v0.14.0 will contain versus what it merely waits for. This may be the sample's data; the code does show the two lists come from separate sources with nothing tying them together.
findings.principle: One fact, one place [SEC-7]; match the user's picture of the work [NNG-H2]
findings.fix: Decide what the section promises and show it. If a task in the Unreleased list is what ships, mark each row that the cut waits for, and list an unfinished waited-for task inside its goal group with its state. If a met item isn't in Unreleased, say where it went, such as its release name in place of 'Done'.

findings.title: Task rows aren't indented under their goal
findings.element: Project page › goal cards at all sizes (rel-webapp-dark-m.png: G4 and T65 share a left edge)
findings.problem: The goal's ref and name sit on the same 16px left edge as its tasks' refs, so G4, T65 and T66 read as one column of equal items. The owner has already corrected this pattern.
findings.principle: LESSONS L1: put the group's label above its members and indent the members under it
findings.fix: Set task_row's left padding to 42px, so refs start under the goal's name, 26px in from the group's ref. Apply it to 'No goal' groups too. Keep the PR and date columns on their right edge.

findings.title: Project page is over-boxed, and a normal wait is drawn as an alarm
findings.element: Project page › Unreleased section (whole surface), 1360x860 and 1728x1084
findings.problem: Blurred, the brown Next cut bar is the brightest thing on the page in a normal state, so a real problem has nothing louder to use. Evidence: boxes run three deep (section, card, row) [SEC-2]. Amber rules separate every Next cut row. The header pill uses warn_soft on a warn_soft bar, so it reads as loose text. The page uses about six text sizes (22, 18, 16, 14, 13, 12) [SCR-3]. The breadcrumb's 'webapp' sits directly above the 'webapp' title [SEC-7].
findings.principle: Group by space, containers only where space can't do it [SEC-2]; one emphasis [SEC-5]; about three type sizes [SCR-3]
findings.fix: Remove the outer box from Unreleased and the newest release: use the 18px heading and spacing, and keep cards only for goals. Draw the Next cut header on t.card with a neutral t.divider between rows, and use the warn tone only for the pill, which then shows as a pill. Save the filled bar for the Can't finish state in R22. Use 22, 14 and 12 as the text sizes, and drop the second 'webapp' from the breadcrumb or keep it only as the title.

findings.title: A failed release doesn't say what failed or where its work went
findings.element: Project page › v0.11.1 row at 1728x1084 (rel-open-dark-l.png); Overview › v0.11.1; the Failed count in the header
findings.problem: The row shows 'Failed' and '0 tasks'. Opening it gives 'No tasks'. The code comment says the work went back to Unreleased, but the UI never says so, so it reads as an empty release. There is no failure time or reason, and the Failed count in the header doesn't lead to the failed rows in a paged list. 'How the work went' is the primary task.
findings.principle: Help users recognise and diagnose errors [NNG-H9]; show status [NNG-H1]
findings.fix: Replace '0 tasks' with 'Work moved to Unreleased' on failed rows, and show the failed_at time in the open row, with the reason if the board has one. Make the header's Failed count scroll to the newest failed release. If the task count before failure isn't in the API, adding it needs a board change.

findings.title: Unreleased and the newest release aren't virtualized
findings.element: Project page › Item::Top and open rows (top, work, release_row)
findings.problem: Only the older-release rows are list items. Unreleased and the newest release, with all their task rows, render as one Top item that is remeasured on every sync, and an open older release is one item too. A release with hundreds of tasks is laid out in full. api's v2.3.0 already has 19 tasks in the sample.
findings.principle: Owner rule: long lists are virtualized; large displays stay responsive [HIG-MACOS]
findings.fix: Flatten the list: make each goal head and task row its own Item, along with Next cut. This also gives R79 its scroll targets. Keep the card look with first and last flags, as the month boxes already do.

findings.title: A failed fetch leaves 'Loading…' on screen
